notes.title: Leaving Early Access!
notes.content:
Hey all, BlueFire here.  Its launch time!  I wanted to take the time to thank the over 1000 players who played during Early Access and provided feedback, bug reports, reviews, and their time.  As a small team it means the world to us that you took a chance on us when we only had a single planet and a grappling hook "finished" and the game was in such a rough state.

We're proud of what we've accomplished in the last 3 years as we've finished 6 planets and revised them hundreds of times.  We went from three puzzles to around a hundred puzzles in the game.  Salli has evolved from just saying a couple things to feeling like a partner on the journey with you.  As of today you'll get some final answers to what happened to the previous crew and reach the conclusion of the journey.  Our team has learned a lot through this journey with this being the first game for most team members.

For those new here, Lodestar tells a short story of a crew that went missing during interstellar travel and the trouble they ran into. Its a shorter game(10-20 hours) with puzzles, crafting, and light combat.

From here on out we plan to fix bugs and any significant gameplay issues based on feedback.  Keep reporting through the in-game feature and we'll keep crushing bugs.  We also plan to add a patch that makes offline play possible to try to allow the game to have the longest shelf life.  Feel free to hop on our discord via the store page or in-game menu (Valve doesn't like discord links in these messages).  You'll also be the first know about new games and have opportunities to weigh-in on what game we make next.

Thanks again for everyone who gave us a shot and feedback.  We look forward to making great new games for you.

[h2]FAQ:[/h2]
Q1: Will my previous saves work? 
A1: Yes.  As far as we know we've never broken saves since the launch of Early Access.  The game has changed significantly so what Salli says to you might be strange at some points but it should work.

Q2: Will you release on other platforms?  
A2: Probably not, but with enough success anything is possible.

Q3: Are you going to continue working on the game?
A3: We plan to fix major bugs and gameplay issues but will likely not add any new content. Launch for us represents finishing the game. If the community can generate enough sales we may be able to afford further development.

Q4: I'm press/influencer how can I get in touch?
A4: I am happy to personally assist in any way that I can.  Hit me up on discord @bluefiresr

notes.title: Patch 6.1.2 Planet 6, New Lore, New Multiplayer Tutorial, Controller Support
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 6.1.2[/h1]

This patch is the candidate for leaving early access and completing our goals with the game.  It brings us to the final boss planet and the inclusion of a lot more lore as well as the ending of the game. We expect to only add full controller support and hopefully simplified chinese language support.  After launching we'll try to address all of the bugs and most of the feedback, so now is the chance to leave any feedback on discord or in reviews for us to work on!  We plan to fully release the game on August 17th.


[h2]Hotfixes:[/h2]
6.1.0 - Full controller Support Added
6.1.1 - Fixed an issue where some players could not complete planet 5 with previous saves
6.1.2 - Fixed an issue with "Getting Started" missions and the grappling hook.

[h2]Major Features:[/h2]
- Planet 6 with final boss and conclusion of the story!
- New player tutorial added (tutorial that is player specific, mostly for multiplayer on-boarding)
- Tons of new lore dialogue spread throughout the game
- Full controller support added, please submit any bugs hit.

[h2]Minor Features:[/h2]
- A few new puzzles
- New monster added on planet 3
- Seeker eyes have been added to the game
- Greenhouse has been reworked at the top of the ship
- Foliage update on planet 1 with new critters
- New sniper scope that doesn't cover up as much of what you are aiming at
- Cool new environmental critter on planet 2
- Navigation updated and should be more reliable for monsters
- Achievements added for Boss 5 & 6 and beating the game

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
- A handful of fixes for the music player
- Grapple gems will no longer pass you through the terrain occasionally
- You can now press the back button on the credits
- Fixed a crash that could occur if you died while firing the SMG
- Fixed a texture bug on planet 4 boss where it would look horrible on lower end graphic settings
- Fixed a bug that could prevent you from beating the game

notes.title: Patch 5.0.57 - Path to Planet 6, Ship Teleporters, and Lore
notes.content:
We'll use this announcement to keep you updated as we approach patch 6.0.0.  We want to be able to ship you improvements sooner so patch 6 will include all these notes but this is to help you understand what's changing in the interim. View the previous announcement for full 5.0.0 changes.

[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]
- After unlocking the teleporter near the first boss (or in saves that have already done this) you will get access to teleporters on the ship. We'd love to have feedback on if this makes the game better or worse in your opinion on discord or the steam forums.
- Two new upgrades dropped without puzzles on planet 5.  These will be moved into puzzles in the future, potentially on other planets.
- Dash strength upgrade removed (it was breaking puzzles) and replaced with an extra dash upgrade.  If you previously unlocked this, you will already have the extra dash upgrade.

[h2]Puzzles:[/h2]
- City of Z pedastal puzzle made slightly bigger at end to help make landing on it easier.
- Atzlan deep truesight puzzle adjusted to make more clear and prevent an accidental cheesy puzzle solution.

[h2]Environment:[/h2]
- City of Z trees are now orange/yellow by default to make the green area stand out more.
- Performance increased while on spaceship
- You now snuff out the light in bats eyes when killing them
- Fixed a bug where some truesight rocks appeared as black.

[h2]Lore:[/h2]
- Salli one liners added by some teleporters
- Fixing grammatical errors
- Lots of localization update and fixes.
- Bomb now has a GED decal referencing Zehra
- Turtle shells are now on Kitzeh to guide you to boss and help you understand how to beat it.  They will be destructible soon.
- New remains added on City of Z near boss.
- New altar near the top of Atzlan
- More line available at cockpit

[h2]UI:[/h2]
- Lore tab and journal adjustments
- Aluminum ore should no longer overflow in some of the UI.
- Ubermenu color adjustments.
- Production UI color adjustments.

[h2]What we're working on:[/h2]
Right now we are leveling up the way we tell the story now that much of the gameplay has been decided.  They'll be a lot more interesting things to see and read as you traverse the planet.  We also plan to keep enriching the game with techniques we've learned.  Additionally we're making fast progress on the final planet to wrap up the story in patch 6.0.0.   Patch 7.0.0 will be the full launch of the game with us leaving early access in a couple months.

notes.title: Patch 5.0 - New Planet, New buildings, French/Turkish Added
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39660716/d4fb190975ffe21fd7f06115192cd1b38245ae11.jpg[/img]

Explore and discover the secrets of the Lost Planet of Z with new puzzles, resources, monsters, and upgrades for you to discover.  We're continuing to fulfill our early access promise of 6 planets with the addition of our 5th planet.  We've take you to exploration, wonder, despair, and danger.  The Lost Planet of Z will now take you to terror.  Part of that is the unknown so we will avoid spoiling too much.  Good luck out there captain!

[h2] Sight Beyond Sight [/h2]

Unveil the hidden secrets and areas utilizing a new ability that will change the way your play and have you reevaluate the journey so far.

[h2]Major Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Planet 5 Launched (boss, monster, resources, upgrades)
[*] New S.B.S. "Truesight" ability
[*] Dozens of new Puzzles, some involving S.B.S., have been added to planets 1-5 with additional upgrades to unlock.
[*] French and Turkish have been added to the games. Thanks to @Sokoul
[*] The building system has been reworked to make it more intuitive and easier to align
[*] New cosmetics are now available to build on the ship. Many are interactable to configure or use. Find one in each planet!
[/list]

[h2]Minor Feature:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Upgrade UI has been significantly improved
[*] HUD UI has been made more slick and sci-fi
[*] Improved progression tracking on analytics
[*] Monsters on planet 4 now have an appropriate cooldown on their fireballs and navigate better
[*] New beacon puzzle type has been added
[*] New invisible wall puzzle type has been added.
[*] Dozens of new Salli lines and additional lore have been added to the game
[*] Lava will no longer be as dark, so you will have more opportunity to survive inside it
[*] Salli will now warn that you don't have the correct equipment to solve certain puzzles.
[*] Lore rewritten to add a new demolitions expert, Zehra.
[*] Planet 3 and 4 have significantly improved visuals.
[*] Water is now more watery.
[*] Environment Shield Visuals improved along with new upgrades.
[*] Improved Subtitle UI significantly.
[*] Performance generally improved in many problematic areas of the game
[/list]

[h2]Hotfixes:[/h2]
     [h3] Patch 5.0.3 [/h3]
- Fixed an issue where titanium recipes would not appear in foundries/refineries.
- Fixed an issue where one mining upgrade required Tungsten
- Fixed an issue where environment shield would constantly active when not on cooldown even when you were not in lava until the game was restarted.

[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Placing buildings should no longer hitch as badly on low-end CPUs
[*] Planet 4 should have increased performance.
[*] It should be much more difficult to accidentally double-trigger a sound crystal
[*] Sound puzzles should no longer repeat the same crystal
[*] Upgrades and Unlocks in multiplayer should no longer disappear on load
[*] Firespitter sounds will not have attenuation
[*] Rock-timed closing puzzles have been adjusted to avoid getting stuck as often
[*] Building should materialize and de-materialize more reliably and correctly in multiplayer
[*] Many strange collision bugs have been fixed. Please keep reporting any you run into via the in-game report feature
[*] Let's get growing quest should now properly complete at each step.
[*] Shiny pop VFX will now play even on last mine.
[*] Planet 1 Boss Lore area should no longer create weird texture stretching on the player
[*] Fixing many areas where localization was not working
[*] Darkened caves will no longer permanently darken a player's game until reloading.
[*] Crabs no longer float in the air and have collision on death
[*] SMG no longer has an infinite firing rate when rapidly clicking
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause Salli to say some of her lines twice
[*] Picking up the mushroom unlock will correctly progress the mission immediately now instead of waiting for a player to harvest one mushroom
[*] Unlocking plants via the cheat menu should no longer cause the player to be unable to complete the relevant missions
[*] Fixed a bug where some planets would occasionally be at half their intended FPS.
[*] Introduction can now be localized.  Additionally filled in a lot of missing localization.
[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
We have two more big goals we want to hit before leaving early access with patch 7.0.0.  First, we need to create the 6th "planet" which will primarily just be an epic boss fight and potentially a handful of extremely challenging puzzles that may require you to have nearly every unlock to complete.  We don't want to focus as much on a large level here so we can put all our effort into final boss fight.

The second goal is to fill the world with more lore and story.  This will include a lot more Salli lines and lore files.  Additionally you'll see more "flavor" added to the planets that will allow players to infer details about the story that are not explicitly stated. We'd love to hear your thoughts on these additions and theories about the truth of the Lodestar story.

Finally we want to polish all existing systems to reflect the higher quality we are now able to deliver on after multiple years of development.  Some of been a little left behind and we want to raise the minimum bar across the board before the full release.  We think that the final boss will be released in a couple months with full launch following shortly after we have resolved all bugs.  Thanks again for coming on this early access journey with us and as always please let us know your thoughts via reviews and discord!

notes.title: Better Environments, Teleporters, Achievements, New Puzzles - 4.3.0 Patch

notes.title: Patch 4.2.0 - Boss Worm Reworked, Planet Visual Overhaul, Mining Ship v3

notes.title: 4.1.0 Graphics Upgrade, Combat Adjustments, 100+ Changes
notes.content:
Hi all, we've been releasing regular hotfixes to the game and listing the changes in Discord.  We're going to be pushing more of these announcements to Steam as well but this will cover all past hotfix patches.  We've broken out what was in hotfixes for those of you who have been following on Discord.

This patch has over 80 changes! Including visual upgrades, bug fixes, performance, and player requested features/changes. We've fixed a lot of the pain points players have addressed in just two weeks.  We'll continue listening to this feedback but you should also expect more content in terms of puzzles and upgrades as well in the next few weeks.  Thank you for your early support of Lodestar and hope we can continue to meet and exceed your expectations!

[h1]Features:[/h1]
- The main ship visuals have been overhauled. Would love to get feedback on this!
- Production UI changed significantly to better help players understand how it works.
- Mining ship controls have been reworked.  Should control much better.
- Sniper now has a zoom.
- Lore spots have been adjusted to better reflect the lore.
- Visuals of planet 1 have been changed significantly to give it more life and better shadows
- Irradiated area on planet 2 now looks more dead and dangerous


[h2]Hotfix Features:[/h2]
- Keymapping on nearly everything should now work. If yours are still broken please delete your file found at
 C:\Users\shaun\AppData\Local\Lodestar\Saved\Config\WindowsNoEditor\Input.ini  [replace shaun with your windows user]
- New icons for all Plants and None Icon
- Shotgun has been reworked.  Now should work better at ultra close range.
- Biotech UI reworked to make it more clear
- Aim Mechanic: Shotgun and SMG can both be aimed (default right click). Aiming reduces bullet spread. We will expand this mechanic to additional weapons.
- Bug Reporter: You can now report bugs to us directly in the game! Bug reporter will:
    - Gather your in-game location
    - Get your key bindings, configs and logs for Lodestar
    - Immediately autosave and attach that save to the report (if you are host).
	
	NOTE: We will keep the Report-A-Bug channel open if you'd prefer to use it, but the in-game Bug Reporter will give us a lot more information up front to help understand, reproduce, and solve your issue and is the best way to let us know of problems moving forward. The in-game report also directly pings us in Discord!
- The music on the ship has been updated! Each level of the ship has a slightly different flavor of the music to help keep things fresh.

[h1]Performance:[/h1]
- The game should load significantly faster now
- Performance on Planet 3 should be comparable to other planets now
- Performance in the ship should be much higher
- Performance when having many production buildings should be much higher
- The game should no longer hitch on mining ores and asteroids.
- Looking at the drop prod should not cause as much of an FPS drop.

[h1]Player Feedback Changes:[/h1]
- The beginning of the game missions now require much less waiting!
- Grappling hook locations have been added to planet 2 to help guide players to boss in a subtle way
- Increased Autosave timer to 5 minutes to prevent all autosaves from being overwritten during a crash.
- Waypoints on early missions around the ship will now help guide the player.
- When the camera gets close to the player they will no turn slightly transparent.
- Lots of small UI adjustments
- Skipping the intro sequence now is a bit more clear, showing a progress bar filling up.
- Some rocks on planet 4 are no longer ridicously shiny.
- Buildings now materialize faster! (5s-1s)
- Healshrooms that you can mine now appear on planet 1

[h2]Hotfix Player Feedback Changes:[/h2]
- Added that the scanner for equipment upgrades is in cockpit to reduce player confusion with the mining ship scanner.
- Bolt Rifle  cost reduced 2000 to 500 zinc plate (10k ore -> 2.5k ore)
- Blue crab health increased 300->400
- Cooker inventory reduced from 100 to 10 (to stop players from losing all their mushrooms unintentionally, use a storage crate to buff storage)
- Production buildings now show two decimal places of precision if under 10 total is in its current inventory to better show production on slower buildings (like the cooker)
- Power from forging levels reduced by 80% while I take time to rebalance it.
- Dishes should have a bit more reasonable numbers.
- Falling into the 4th boss will now kill you instantly rather than a slow death
- Increased cost of some T3 upgrades to encourage players to move forward to earn more mining power.
- Reduced strength of later level damage upgrades to prevent 1-shotting in more cases.
- Reduced forging power on all upgrades to encourage building more production buildings
- Reduced movement speed buff from 5% to 2% so upon unlocking all 20 you are no longer Sonic.
- Fixed a pricing error on Tier 5 health regen. 
- Cookers will now play a "ding", stop spinning, and light up your cooked food once they run out of ingredients or fill up.
- Production buildings that cannot fulfill their recipe cannot have the boost button pressed, making it more clear when you're out of ingredients or the building is full. (e.g. if you run out of ore in the Foundry) 
- Shotgun muzzle flash improved
- For clarity, you can no longer click "Collect" on empty production buildings (button is disabled until some output is stored)
- Waypoints for the planet 1 mission should help players better navigate the first planet.

[h1]BugFixes:[/h1]
- Fixed bug on load that would cause you to have to reconfigure buildings to get correct figures.
- Fixed bug on load that could cause buildings to not appear
- Fixed bug on load that could cause equipment to not appear on the hud.
- Fixed bug on joining that could cause joining players to lose their progress if game saved while they joined.
- Inventory will no longer show tin ore when you have nothing
- Fixed bugs around aiming and changing your equipment
- Fixed a bug that could cause players to get stuck on Mushroom quest.
- Health bars should no longer hang around after a boss dies
- Fixed a crash on clients when falling into abysses
- Shotgun shells should now look correct in multiplayer
- Dead players and bats no longer fall through planet 3

[h2]Hotfix Bugs:[/h2]
- Fixed Hole Near Grappling Range Upgrade
- Several locations fixed on planet 1 where you could get outside the map
- Several locations fixed on Planet 2 where you could get outside the map
- Scanner should be more reliable on clients.
- Negative numbers now display better
- Players joining games should no longer freeze on load
- Unstuck will now unfreeze you character if you get the bug on rejoining a game where you float and can't move. (you can also try loading the game with them in the lobby)  Thanks everyone for reporting and helping us narrow down.
- Unstuck will now remove infinite grapple hangtime
- Fixed Infinite Grapple Hang Time (please report if you see it come back)
- Crystalline Creeper renamed to Crystal Creeper
- Fixed a bug that would cause some resources to push off the right side of the screen when collected.
- Fixed crashes that could occur when two players fell in the same lava pit
- Fixed bugs where client lava pit effects could apply to server and vice versa.
- Fixed crash that would occur on phase 2 of the third boss when playing multiplayer
- Fixed typos in missions
- Planters and Production should now show correct resources on a loaded game
- You can no longer lose focus and fail to close production menus.
- Fixed a bunch of lighting artifacts on the ship which also increased performance
- Fixed a bug where things previous discovered could appear as undiscovered on load
- Production Particles should be more reliable
- Buildings should now materialize properly on clients when returning to the ship.
- Fixed collision on some coral on planet 2 that accidentally had it turned on instead of off
- Foundries will now appropriately show production smoke when the game is loaded if they are producing something.
- Foundries will now appropriately STOP showing production smoke/sparks when running out of ingredients or filling up. 
- You can now press "C" to collect while the production menu is open
- Habitation rooms now have proper clipping and cannot be entered. If you built something in there, consider it part of a museum now!
- Shotgun should be much more consistent for your buddies that connect to you with slow internet or from far away.
- Buildings must produce at least once before being collected. Essentially, spamming "Collect" on buildings is no longer faster than normal building production speed. PROTIP: Building multiple buildings helps you produce way faster!
- You can now properly rebind Z (better AZERTY keyboard support)
- Fixed bug where opening the ESC or O menu while in a ship would prevent all game interaction, forcing you to restart the game.
- Fixed edge case where widgets for production could still appear when out of range.


[h1]What we're working on now:[/h1]
- Updating to Unreal Engine 5
- Localization (if you want to help feel free to reach out to us on Discord)
- New puzzles!
- Visual upgrading the planets to match the new fidelity of the ship.
- Planet 5

Thank you again for all the feedback and reviews.  A big shoutout to those using the bug reporter and helping provide feedback on Discord as well.  We hope to see you there to help us continue to make the best game we can!

notes.title: Early Access has Launched! v4.0.0
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome everyone to the Early Access launch of Lodestar![/h1]

There are too many additions and changes to cover in a single patch note so we'll cover what's there now and what's coming.

[h2]There Now![/h2]
[list]
[*][b]4 Planets to visit with 4 Bosses[/b]
[*][b]Mining[/b]
[*][b]Asteroid Harvesting[/b]
[*][b]Crafting and Production[/b]
[*][b]160+ Upgrades[/b]
[*][b]8 Pieces of Equipment[/b]
[*][b]Dozens of unlocks and puzzles to solve[/b]
[*][b]New character colors to unlock[/b]
[/list]


[h2]Coming Soon[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Additional planets.[/b] At least 2 "planets", could be a few more if you get your friends to buy the game.
[*][b]Localization.[/b]  If you want to help let us know on discord.
[*][b]Features You Ask For On Discord.[/b]  For real, we made dozens of features for Valgrave and Lodestar will be no different.
[*][b]Bugfixes.[/b] We're sorry.  We got all the ones we could find with our small team.
[/list]

These are in no particular order and done by very different people so we'll work as hard and quickly as we can.


[h2]How You Can Help Make Lodestar Better[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Reviews matter a lot.[/b]  Positive or negative they teach us what we should do.
[*][b]Telling Your Friends.[/b] We're a full independent game with no marketing budget.  Hopefully the love and sweat we've dumped into it helps you become our marketer.
[*][b]Get Involved on Discord.[/b] We're be responding a lot there.  Get on in and fill up suggestions, feedback, and bug reports.
[/list]

[h2]Disclaimer About Our Release Schedule[/h2]
We launch fast and hard.  That means we'll likely patch the game multiple times a week if not multiple times a day.  Our patches are like X.X.X.  The first X will let you know what planet is out.  The second X increasing means a significant (probably requested) feature came out.  The third X are the bug fixes.

We really appreciate you taking the time to try out Lodestar.  It means the world to us.  We're just a group of friends with other jobs who have put this game together with many countless late nights. <3
-Shaun "BlueFire" Randall


[h2]Updates Since EA Launch[/h2]

Bugs:
- Fixed hole near Grappling Range upgrade

Feedback:
- Added note that the scanner for equipment upgrades is in the cockpit so players don't confuse it for the mining ship scanner.

notes.title: Upcoming Early Access Launch July 8th
notes.content:
[h1]Launch Information[/h1]
We're happy to announce that we'll be launching to Early Access on [b]July 8th[/b] immediately after the Steam Sale ends!

[h1]Some notes about Early Access[/h1]
[list]
[*] The demo will no longer be available and saves will be incompatible with the new version as much balancing has taken place.
[*] The game will be initially priced at around 30 USD with a 10% launch discount.
[*] A ton of new features and upgrades to existing features will be launched. Check out the new trailer to see a lot of the improvements to the game.
[*] Planets 3 and 4 will be added to the game along with their respective resources, upgrades, equipment, and bosses.
[/list]

[h1]Thank you![/h1]
Thank you all for the feedback and your time testing out the game.  We hope you'll continue to join us through Early Access to make Lodestar the best game it can be.

notes.title: Patch Notes 2.2.0
notes.content:
Overall we have been working on performance and polish of the game as we approach Early Access (tentatively Late June / Early July).  Most features have been implemented, now we just need to beef up the amount of content for you all.  Please let us know what you think!

Gameplay
- New Unlocks added to Planet 2
- Planet 2 now has a lot more sharks 
- Planet 2 now has crabs
- Revamp of all gun particles

- Scorpions can now be interrupted if shot mid attack
- Scorpion attacks can now be dodged
- New small scorpions introduced
- Scorpions will now hear people running.  Use shift to walk and sneak past.

- A TON more Salli dialogue
- Now adjust sound volume based on the situation (ex: Reducing music when Salli talks)
- Added a scanner to the game near the hologram.  Will be doing more with this later.

- Upgraded the turn and movement animations of Player

UI
- Nearly every part of the UI has been redone.  Still a WIP.
- Animations have been added to the UI in many places.

Ship Changes
- Polished the ship's connecting parts and lighting
- Redid the greenhouse at the top of the ship
- Landing Ship recall button made more obvious
- Buildings are now more appropriately sized to their blocked area.

Performance
- Reduced memory from an average of 1800MB to about 800MB
- Created new profiles for low and high end machines.  Should make all machines look and perform better.

Bugs:
- Fixed a crash of mining leftover shinies
- Fixed a bug that could cause you to get stuck in the game after blowing up the hidden cave.
- Fixed a bug that would cause a double equip issue
- Fixed a bug that would cause the HUD to break on non-standard aspect ratios/resolutions
- Fixed icons not appearing on taskbar
- Fixed some sounds not attenuating
- Fixed multiplayer door bugs
- Fixed a bug that would show all players as playing Lodestar in lobby.
- Fixed a bug that would cause light shafts on planet 2 to not appear
- Fixed a bunch of collision issues
- Fixed a bug that could cause multiplayer mining to not work
- Closed a bunch of holes in the world
- Fixed a bug with projectile multiplayer syncing (most noticeable on grappling hook)

Progress Report Toward Early Access:
- Planet 3 completed (level, boss, monster)
- Boss 2 completed
- Planet 4 Started
- Flying navigation implemented (new flying monsters)

Next Goals
- Finish Planet 4
- Redo trailer
- A lot of polish
- Launch Early Access

notes.title: Patch Notes 2.1.0
notes.content:
We spent the last month polishing what we've made as well as starting on planet 3 that will only be available EA and onward. Although we still have some UI improvements and bug fixes, the game is much closer to the quality level we expect to ship EA at.

Major Features:
- You now have to get special pickups to get upgrades in the equipment station.  Find them scattered throughout planet 1!
- Movement animations have been rehauled to provide a better experience.
- Mining rehauled.  Now shiny spots will appear to allow you to mine faster.  Mining is now more realistic
- HUGE performance improvements.  Most players will see anywhere from 2x FPS on high-end machines to 10x FPS on low-end machines.
- Equipment now changes visuals significantly based on how many upgrades you have attained

Features from your Feedback:
- Widescreen support for the UI
- Fog now behaves a lot better on planets
- Blood from monsters now a lot more realistic
- UI now has more consistent behavior
- Doors on the ship open much faster
- Tons of sound changes and fixes

Bug Fixes:
- You no longer sometimes shoot two grappling hooks on non-hosts
- You can no longer infinitely mine resources by switching weapons while mining
- Tons of further fixes and QoL to the save system
- Collision and physics tweaks to dead sharks
- Boss will no longer damage you after dying
- Overlapping music should be fixed.
- Character now holds the mining laser correctly

Known Bugs (we're working on them):
- Sometimes non-hosts can shoot two grappling hooks
- You can fly the ship down to the planet (this does nothing)
- Saving while in the dropship/personalship will be a bad time
- Non-host droppod can be laggy and have animation problems.

Project Progress (NOT IN DEMO):
- Planet 3 almost done
- New Flying navigation system for new AI
- Lava added to the gameplay
- Planet 4 started

notes.title: Patch 2.0.0 - Planet 2, New Boss, Visual Overhaul, Ability Reworks
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/GZZhypctFd]Discord Server for Feedback and Friends[/url]

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:

Waypoints have been added to the game.  Finding the drop pod and hidden cave has never been easier.

- You should not longer be able to equip two items at once
- Entering and exiting the personal ship will no longer brick your UI
